nos appellassemus, eámque appellationem repudiare se non posse. Tum
ille, quasi leo rugiens, Tu igitur, inquit, non vis in hos sceleratos ho-

page.notes: Left margin notes, as printed: "Prouocatio à sententia iudicum." (beside the first lines); "Gehenna conscientiæ impiè." (first word and last word uncertain, impiè marked); "Lupusoues ferunt." (first word doubtful, marked; the printed mark is a small hand-pointing sign, not transcribed). Also a printed manicule beside the "Gehenna" note. "Dei erga suos prouidentia." is printed in the left margin beside "gratias agere" and was not transcribed; it belongs to the margin note series and should be added as a note before "gratias" at its place. Possible misprint "sesquihoram" (scan reads "fefquiboram"); marked. Running head "Quinq.Schol." is set with a stroke under "Quinq." in the print. Page number absent.
